zh.title: RUDY 拥塞估计
bullets: Congestion · Lesson 04
矩形均匀布线密度
在布线之前，估计导线会挤在哪里
zh.notes: 这一课讲 RUDY：在布线之前，用每个线网的包围盒估计哪些区域会拥塞。

en.title: RUDY congestion estimate
bullets: Congestion · Lesson 04
Rectangular Uniform wire DensitY
Before routing, estimate where the wires will crowd
en.notes: This lesson is about RUDY: estimating, before routing, which regions will be congested, from each net's bounding box.

zh.title: 问题：线长够了，为什么还要看拥塞
bullets: HPWL 回答“线大概有多长”
同样的总长，可以均匀铺开，也可以挤在一处
挤的地方要绕线、换层，甚至布不通
第二个问题：线会挤在哪里？
zh.notes: 上一课的 HPWL 只给一个总数。两种布局总线长相同，拥塞可能完全不同，所以布局还需要一张“哪里挤”的图。

en.title: Problem: why congestion, when we have wirelength
bullets: HPWL answers “how long will the wires be?”
The same total can be spread out or piled up
Crowded regions force detours, layer changes, failures
Second question: where will the wires crowd?
en.notes: HPWL gives one total. Two layouts with the same total can differ completely in congestion, so placement also needs a map of where the wires crowd.

zh.title: 布线格与需求图
bullets: 12 × 8 的芯片切成 4 × 2 个格
每格宽 3、高 4
需求存成 demand[x][y]：先列 x，后行 y
每格容量 C = 2
zh.notes: 我们把芯片切成布线格，每个格记一个需求值。下标的顺序和老师的代码一致：先列后行。

en.title: Routing tiles and the demand map
bullets: The 12 × 8 chip is cut into 4 × 2 tiles
Each tile is 3 wide and 4 tall
Demand is stored demand[x][y]: column x, then row y
Capacity C = 2 per tile
en.notes: We cut the chip into routing tiles and keep one demand value per tile, indexed column first as in the teacher's code.

zh.title: 一个线网：包围盒与 HPWL
bullets: 包围盒宽 7、高 4
这 11 就是 RUDY 要分出去的量
zh.notes: 先看一个线网。它的包围盒宽 7、高 4，所以半周长线长等于 11。

en.title: One net: bounding box and HPWL
bullets: Box width 7, height 4
RUDY hands out these 11 units
en.notes: Start with one net. Its box is 7 wide and 4 tall, so its HPWL is 11.

zh.title: 格下标：向下取整，再夹紧
bullets: i = ⌊x / 格宽⌋，j = ⌊y / 格高⌋
x = 3 压在边线上：属于右边的第 1 列
x = 12 被夹回最后一列
zh.notes: 边界上的点必须有明确规则。本课用向下取整再夹紧：压在 x 等于 3 的点属于右边一列。

en.title: Tile index: round down, then clamp
bullets: i = ⌊x / tile width⌋, j = ⌊y / tile height⌋
then clamp into [0, nx − 1] and [0, ny − 1]
x = 3 lies on an edge: column 1, to its right
x = 12 is clamped into the last column
en.notes: A point on an edge needs a stated rule. Here we round down, then clamp: x = 3 belongs to the column on its right.

zh.title: 选中的格：端点格规则
bullets: 每格加 11 / 6
zh.notes: 求包围盒两个角各自所在的格，再选中它们之间的全部格子。ABCD 选中 6 格，每格加六分之十一。

en.title: Selected tiles: the endpoint-tile rule
bullets: Lower-left (1, 1) is in tile (0, 0)
Upper-right (8, 5) is in tile (2, 1)
Select every tile from (0,0) to (2,1): 3 × 2 = 6
Each tile gets 11 / 6
en.notes: Find the tiles of the box's two corners and select every tile between them. ABCD selects 6 tiles; each gets eleven sixths.

zh.title: 六个线网叠加成需求图
bullets: AB、CD、AC、BD、ABCD、EF 依次加入
每个线网只处理一次
八个格的需求加起来 = 34
正好等于 HPWL 总和：需求守恒
zh.notes: 六个线网依次加入，叠成整张需求图。总和是 34，正好等于所有线网的 HPWL 之和。

en.title: Six nets stack into the demand map
bullets: AB, CD, AC, BD, ABCD, EF are added in turn
Each net is processed once
The eight tiles sum to 34
Exactly the total HPWL: demand is conserved
en.notes: The six nets are added one by one into the demand map. It sums to 34, exactly the total HPWL.

zh.title: 容量、比值与溢出
bullets: 比值 = 需求 ÷ C
溢出 = max(0, 需求 − C)
C = 2：6 格溢出，总溢出 22，最大 14/3
C = 1：总溢出 28，最大 17/3；需求不变
zh.notes: 容量只改变读数。容量从 2 降到 1，需求图一个数都不变，变的是比值和溢出。

en.title: Capacity, ratio and overflow
bullets: ratio = demand ÷ C
overflow = max(0, demand − C)
C = 2: 6 tiles over, total 22, max 14/3
C = 1: total 28, max 17/3; demand unchanged
en.notes: Capacity only changes the readings. Dropping it from 2 to 1 leaves every demand value as it is; ratio and overflow change.

zh.title: 比较摆法：先说清楚指标
bullets: 中心聚集：HPWL 总和 7，总溢出 5
展开：HPWL 总和 34，总溢出 22
但聚集把需求压进一个格：7 / 2 = 3.5 倍容量
比较之前先说清楚：看总溢出、最大值还是峰值比值
zh.notes: 聚集的摆法总溢出更小，却把全部需求压进一个格。比较之前必须先说清楚用哪个指标。

en.title: Comparing layouts: name the metric first
bullets: Centre cluster: total HPWL 7, total overflow 5
Spread: total HPWL 34, total overflow 22
But the cluster puts all demand in one tile: 3.5 × capacity
Say first whether you compare total, max, or peak ratio
en.notes: The cluster has less total overflow but crams all demand into one tile. Name the metric before you compare.

zh.title: 模型 A：按面积分配
bullets: 每格加 HPWL × 重叠面积 / 盒子面积
另有水平 H、垂直 V 两张图
退化成线段的盒子按长度分配（本课规则）
同一摆法：最大需求从 20/3 ≈ 6.67 变成 7.54
zh.notes: 按面积分配时，格子分到的量与它和包围盒的重叠面积成正比。模型不同，热点的数字也不同。

en.title: Model A: share by area
bullets: Each tile gets HPWL × overlap area / box area
Plus horizontal H and vertical V maps
A box that degenerates to a line is shared by length
Same layout: max demand 20/3 ≈ 6.67 becomes 7.54
en.notes: Sharing by area gives each tile a part proportional to its overlap with the box. A different model gives different hotspot numbers.

zh.title: 伪代码
bullets: 先验证，再计算
每个线网：包围盒 → 两个角的格 → 平均分配
最后用容量读出比值与溢出
zh.notes: 代码先验证输入，再逐个线网分配需求，最后才用容量。

en.title: Pseudocode
bullets: Validate first, then compute
Each net: box → corner tiles → equal share
Capacity is used only at the end
en.notes: The code validates its input, then deposits each net, and uses capacity only at the end.

zh.title: RUDY 不能告诉你的事
bullets: 只看包围盒：不知道导线真正怎么走
模型 P 没有方向、没有金属层
数字依赖格的大小和边界规则
它是布线前的估计，不是布线结果
zh.notes: RUDY 快，但它只是估计。真正的拥塞要靠全局布线来确认。

en.title: What RUDY cannot tell you
bullets: It only sees bounding boxes, not real routes
Model P has no direction and no metal layers
Numbers depend on tile size and the edge rule
It is an estimate before routing, not a routing result
en.notes: RUDY is fast, but it is an estimate. Real congestion is confirmed by global routing.

Do the seven challenges: they check your actual layout
